assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The current study boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional working geometries because complete official polygons were not available in the open repository at concept-lock stage.
assumptions.impact: All spatial quantities and drawings must be recalculated together after official geometry is obtained; provisional geometry must never be presented as an official redline or statutory control.

assumptions.statement: Existing-resident retention, affordable housing and shop baselines, accessibility continuity, summer shade, noise, air quality, and storm-safe-route conditions require field or authoritative baseline data.
assumptions.impact: These people-first indicators are design commitments but remain baseline-pending until they can be measured, sourced, and independently reviewed.

assumptions.statement: The Stage 1 context map uses an OpenStreetMap Overpass snapshot dated 2026-08-09 to locate background networks and selected mapped objects.
assumptions.impact: OSM completeness and positional accuracy are not assumed; mapped objects cannot be counted as an authoritative facility inventory or used for official redlines, engineering design, accessibility conclusions or statutory controls.
